picks.editorial_note: Two Purdue AI projects were selected among the first awards under the federal Genesis Mission — a marquee national AI research initiative whose inaugural funding cohort signals where US government AI research priorities are headed.
picks.title: Category: Research

picks.editorial_note: A three-way $1.2M NSF award teams USF, Purdue, and UT Dallas to fuse quantum-resistant cryptography with AI-enabled network defense, addressing a security gap that will matter as quantum computing threatens current encryption standards.
picks.title: USF faculty secure $1.2M NSF grant to advance quantum-secure, AI-enabled wireless networks

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen's nationwide German permit for its Level-4 autonomous research vehicle, built on an open-source driving stack, is a concrete regulatory milestone that could accelerate real-world autonomous vehicle deployment across the country.
picks.title: RWTH Receives Nationwide Testing Permit for Autonomous Research Vehicle “karl.” | RWTH Aachen University | EN

picks.editorial_note: SRI's use of mechanistic interpretability to diagnose and correct generative model behavior tackles one of AI safety's hardest open problems — understanding what's actually happening inside frontier models rather than just their outputs.
picks.title: Responsible AI: Inside SRI's race to make generative models safe - SRI

picks.editorial_note: A prominent call from Helmholtz researchers for Europe to build sovereign open frontier AI models reflects a growing geopolitical debate over AI dependence on US and Chinese systems, with real implications for research funding and policy in the EU.
picks.title: Why we in Germany and Europe need to build our own open frontier models

picks.editorial_note: Princeton's finding that AI models misread key details in police bodycam footage roughly 1 in 4 times has direct consequences for how courts and departments should (or shouldn't) trust automated video analysis in accountability cases.
picks.title: AI tools can miss the mark on police bodycam footage

picks.editorial_note: A University of Toledo AI model that flags osteoporosis risk from CT scans already ordered for other purposes could enable years-earlier diagnosis at essentially no added cost, a rare case of near-term deployable clinical AI.
picks.title: UToledo Researchers Develop AI Tool to Detect Osteoporosis Risk Using Existing CT Scans | UToledo News

picks.editorial_note: UAB's Spiromatics startup is commercializing AI-derived lung imaging biomarkers for COPD, translating years of academic research into a real diagnostic product — a concrete example of university science reaching patients.
picks.title: UAB startup brings decades of research to the future of lung care

picks.editorial_note: Aalto University researchers, including one building new mathematical foundations for safe continual reinforcement learning, won competitive ERC Starting Grants, reflecting strong European investment in foundational AI safety research.
picks.title: Three rising Aalto University researchers secure highly sought-after EU funding | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A TU Wien robot automating tens of thousands of materials science measurements a year could dramatically accelerate the data pipeline feeding AI-driven catalyst discovery, addressing a key bottleneck in computational materials science.
picks.title: A Robot Teaching Computers to Find Better Catalysts
